name: Fortifying Brew
description: Turns your skin to stone for 15 sec.

name: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger
description: Summons an effigy of Xuen, the White Tiger for 20 sec. Xuen attacks your primary target, and strikes 3 enemies within 10 yards every 0.9 sec with Tiger Lightning for 8 Nature damage.

name: Celestial Conduit
description: The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 387 Nature damage onto enemies and 20,555 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.6 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.\n\nYou may move while channeling, but casting other healing or damaging spells cancels this effect.

name: Paralysis
description: Incapacitates the target for 1 min. Limit 1. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Tiger's Lust
description: Increases a friendly target's movement speed by 70% for 6 sec and removes all roots and snares.

name: Rising Sun Kick
description: Kick upwards, dealing 49 Physical damage.

name: Transcendence
description: Split your body and spirit, leaving your spirit behind for 15 min. Use Transcendence: Transfer to swap locations with your spirit.

name: Thunder Focus Tea
description:
Receive a jolt of energy, empowering your next spell cast:

Enveloping Mist: Immediately heals for 2,784 and is instant cast.
Renewing Mist: Duration increased by 10 sec.
Rising Sun Kick: Cooldown reduced by 9 sec.

name: Life Cocoon
description: Encases the target in a cocoon of Chi energy for 12 sec, absorbing 14,664 damage and increasing all healing over time received by 50%.

name: Diffuse Magic
description: Activating Fortifying Brew transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.

name: Enveloping Mist
description: Wraps the target in healing mists, healing for 3,189 over 6 sec, and increasing healing received from your other spells by 10%.

name: Mana Tea
description:
For every 3,000 Mana you spend, you gain 1 stack of Mana Tea, with a chance equal to your critical strike chance to generate 1 extra stack.

Mana Tea:
Consumes 1 stack of Mana Tea per 0.4 sec to restore 648 Mana.

Can be cast while moving, but movement speed is reduced by 40% while channeling.

name: Sheilun's Gift
description: Draws in all nearby clouds of mist, healing the friendly target and up to 2 nearby allies for 1,584 and an additional 79 per cloud absorbed.\n\nA cloud of mist is generated every 8 sec while in combat.

name: Soothing Mist
description: Heals the target for 6,386 over 7.1 sec. While channeling, Enveloping Mist and Vivify may be cast instantly on the target.

name: Invoke Chi-Ji, the Red Crane
description: Summon an effigy of Chi-Ji for 25 sec that kicks up 3 Gust of Mists when you Blackout Kick, Rising Sun Kick, or Spinning Crane Kick, healing up to 2 allies for 0.\n\nChi-Ji's presence makes you immune to movement impairing effects, makes Enveloping Mist instant cast, and reduces the mana cost of Enveloping Mist by 20%.

name: Invoke Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent
description: Summons an effigy of Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent for 25 sec. Yu'lon will heal injured allies with Soothing Breath, healing the target and up to 2 allies for 797 over 4.0 sec. \n\nEnveloping Mist costs 50% less mana while Yu'lon is active.

name: Ring of Peace
description: Form a Ring of Peace at the target location for 5 sec. Enemies that enter will be ejected from the Ring.

name: Song of Chi-Ji
description: Conjures a cloud of hypnotic mist that slowly travels forward. Enemies touched by the mist fall asleep, Disoriented for 20 sec.

name: Rushing Wind Kick
description: Kick up a powerful gust of wind, dealing 62 Nature damage in a 25 yd cone to enemies in front of you, split evenly among them. Damage is increased by 6% for each target hit, up to 30%.

name: Summon Jade Serpent Statue
description: Summons a Jade Serpent Statue at the target location. When you channel Soothing Mist, the statue will also begin to channel Soothing Mist on your target, healing for 2,128 over 7.1 sec.

name: Restoral
description:
Heals all party and raid members within 40 yds for 22,203 and clears them of all harmful Poison and Disease effects. 

Castable while stunned.

Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Revival
description: Heals all party and raid members within 40 yds for 22,452 and clears them of 3 harmful Magic, all Poison, and all Disease effects.\n\nHealing reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Chi Torpedo
description: Torpedoes you forward a long distance and increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 sec, stacking up to 2 times.

name: Disable
description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec, duration refreshed by your melee attacks.

name: Touch of Death
description: You exploit the enemy target's weakest point, instantly dealing damage equal to 100% of your maximum health to them.\n\nOnly usable on creatures that have less health than you.

name: Touch of Fatality
description: Instantly kills any creature under level 50, or player under 20% health.

name: Leg Sweep
description: Knocks down all enemies within 6 yards, stunning them for 3 sec.

name: Zen Pilgrimage
description: Your spirit travels to your home temple, leaving your body behind. \n\nUse Zen Pilgrimage again to return back to near your departure point.

name: Expel Harm
description: Expel negative chi from your body, healing for 467 and dealing 10% of the amount healed as Nature damage to an enemy within 20 yards.

name: Provoke
description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Blackout Kick
description: Kick with a blast of Chi energy, dealing 30 Physical damage.

name: Roll
description: Roll a short distance.

name: Chi Burst
description:
Hurls a torrent of Chi energy up to 40 yds forward, dealing 98 Nature damage to all enemies, and 77 healing to the Monk and all allies in its path. Healing and damage reduced beyond 5 targets.


Casting Chi Burst does not prevent avoiding attacks.

name: Chi Wave
description: Every 15 sec, your next Rising Sun Kick or Vivify releases a wave of Chi energy that flows through friends and foes, dealing 6 Nature damage or 20 healing. Bounces up to 7 times to targets within 25 yards.

name: Crackling Jade Lightning
description: Channel Jade lightning, causing 9 Nature damage over 3.6 sec to the target and sometimes knocking back melee attackers.

name: Detox
description: Removes all Magic effects from the target.

name: Fists of Fury
description: Pummels all targets in front of you, dealing 456 Physical damage to your primary target and 274 damage to all other enemies over 3.6 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. Can be channeled while moving.

name: Flying Serpent Kick
description: Soar forward through the air at high speed for 1.5 sec.\n \nIf used again while active, you will land, reducing the movement speed of enemies within 8 yds by 70% for 4 sec.

name: Healing Sphere
description: When you kill an enemy, you summon a Healing Sphere, healing you for 69 when you walk through it.

name: Reawaken
description: Returns all dead party members to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Renewing Mist
description: Surrounds the target with healing mists, restoring 837 health over 20 sec.\n\nIf Renewing Mist heals a target past maximum health, it will travel to another injured ally within 20 yds.

name: Resuscitate
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Spinning Crane Kick
description: Spin while kicking in the air, dealing 14 Physical damage over 1.3 sec to all enemies within 8 yds. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Tiger Palm
description: Strike with the palm of your hand, dealing 31 Physical damage.

name: Touch of Karma
description: Absorbs all damage taken for 10 sec, up to 50% of your maximum health, and redirects 70% of that amount to the enemy target as Nature damage over 6 sec.

name: Vivify
description: Causes a surge of invigorating mists, healing the target for 959.

name: Zen Flight
description: You fly through the air at a quick speed on a meditative cloud.

name: Zen Pilgrimage/Death Gate/Moonglade Storage Aura I
Zen Pilgrimage: Return
description: Returns your spirit back to its body, returning you near to where you once were.\n\nLeaving Peak of Serenity will cancel Zen Pilgrimage: Return.

name: Mighty Ox Kick
description: You perform a Mighty Ox Kick, hurling your enemy a distance behind you.

name: Absolute Serenity
description: Celestial Conduit now prevents all crowd control for its duration.

name: Counteract Magic
description: Removing hostile magic effects from a target increases the healing they receive from you by 10% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.

name: Dematerialize
description: Demateralize into mist while stunned, reducing damage taken by 30%. Each second you remain stunned reduces this bonus by 10%.

name: Eminence
description: Transcendence: Transfer can now be cast if you are stunned. Cooldown reduced by 15 sec if you are not.

name: Healing Spheres
description: Your healing has a chance to coalesces a Healing Sphere out of the mists at your target's location after 1.5 sec. If allies walk through it, they consume the sphere, healing themselves for 1,667 and dispelling all harmful periodic magic effects.\n\nMaximum of 3 Healing Spheres can be active by the Monk at any given time.

name: Peaceweaver
description: Revival's cooldown is reduced by 16%, and provides immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 2 sec.

name: Zen Focus Tea
description: Thunder Focus Tea provides immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 5 sec.

name: Zen Spheres
description:
Soothing Mist, Crackling Jade Lightning, and Rising Sun Kick form a sphere of Hope or Despair above their targets. Only one of each sphere can be active at a time.

 Sphere of Hope: Increases your healing done to the target by 10%.
 Sphere of Despair: Target deals 3% less damage and takes 10% increased damage from all sources.

name: Transcendence: Linked Spirits
description: Transcendence now tethers your spirit onto an ally for 1 hour. Use Transcendence: Transfer to teleport to your ally's location.

name: Amplified Rush
description: The healing of Gusts of Mist caused by Renewing Mist is increased by 100%.

name: Ancient Arts
description: Reduces the cooldown of Paralysis by 15 sec and the cooldown of Leg Sweep by 10 sec.

name: Aspect of Harmony
description: Store vitality from 10% of your damage dealt and 30% of your healing.\n\nFor 10 sec after casting Thunder Focus Tea your spells and abilities draw upon the stored vitality to deal 40% additional healing over 8 sec.

name: Balanced Stratagem
description: Casting a Physical spell or ability increases the damage and healing of your next Fire or Nature spell or ability by 3%, and vice versa. Stacks up to 5.

name: Bounding Agility
description: Roll and Chi Torpedo travel a small distance further.

name: Burst of Life
description: When Life Cocoon expires, it releases a burst of mist that restores 3,062 health to 3 nearby allies.

name: Calming Coalescence
description: The absorb amount of Life Cocoon is increased by 80%.

name: Calming Presence
description: Reduces all damage taken by 3%.

name: Celerity
description: Reduces the cooldown of Roll by 5 sec and increases its maximum number of charges by 1.

name: Celestial Determination
description: While your Celestial is active, you cannot be slowed below 90% normal movement speed.

name: Celestial Harmony
description:
When activated, Yu'lon and Chi-Ji apply Chi Cocoons to 5 targets within 40 yds, absorbing 7,332 damage for 10 sec.

Chi-Ji grants 4 stacks of Teachings of the Monastery when invoked.

Yu'lon reduces the cast speed of Enveloping Mist by 30%.

name: Chi Proficiency
description: Magical damage done increased by 5% and healing done increased by 5%.

name: Chi Transfer
description: Touch of Death now heals you for 50% of its damage done.

name: Chi Warding
description: You heal for 3% of all magical damage taken.

name: Chi-Ji's Swiftness
description: Your movement speed is increased by 75% during Celestial Conduit and by 15% for 3 sec after being assisted by any Celestial.

name: Chrysalis
description: Reduces the cooldown of Life Cocoon by 45 sec.

name: Clarity of Purpose
description: Casting Enveloping Mist stores 1,140 additional vitality.

name: Coalescence
description:
When Aspect of Harmony heals, it has a chance to spread to a nearby ally. When you directly heal an affected target, it has a chance to intensify, withdrawing additional vitality to increase its effect by up to 20%.

Vivify no longer contributes vitality. While Aspect of Harmony is not active, Vivify instead draws on available vitality to deal an additional 100% healing over 8 sec.

Vitality stored by other abilities is increased by 50%.

name: Courage of the White Tiger
description: Xuen claws your target for 118 Physical damage, healing a nearby ally for 100% of the damage done.\n\nInvoking a celestial guarantees your next cast activates this effect.

name: Crane Style
description: Rising Sun Kick now kicks up a Gust of Mist to heal 2 allies within 40 yds for 0. \n\nSpinning Crane Kick and Blackout Kick have a chance to kick up a Gust of Mist to heal 1 ally within 40 yds for 0.

name: Crashing Momentum
description: Targets you Roll through are snared by 40% for 5 sec.

name: Dance of Chi-Ji
description: Your spells and abilities have a chance to make your next Spinning Crane Kick deal an additional 400% damage.

name: Dance of the Wind
description: Your physical damage taken is reduced by 10% and an additional 10% every 4 sec until you receive a physical attack.

name: Dancing Mists
description: Renewing Mist has a 8% chance to immediately spread to an additional target when initially cast or when traveling to a new target.

name: Deep Clarity
description: After you fully consume Thunder Focus Tea, your next Vivify triggers Zen Pulse.

name: Elusive Mists
description: Reduces all damage taken by you and your target while channeling Soothing Mists by 6%.

name: Emperor's Elixir
description:
Thunder Focus Tea now empowers Enveloping Mist and Rising Sun Kick further.

 Enveloping Mist:
Begins a channel of Soothing Mist onto your target.

 Rising Sun Kick:
Releases a Jadefire Stomp infront of you that transfers damage into Ancient Teachings at 20% effectiveness.

 Jadefire Stomp:
You release a Jadefire Stomp, dealing 35 damage to 5 enemies in front of you.

name: Emperor's Favor
description: Sheilun's Gift's healing is increased by 20% and its cast time is reduced by 100%, but it now only heals a single ally.

name: Endless Draught
description: Thunder Focus Tea has 1 additional charge.

name: Energizing Brew
description: Mana Tea now channels 50% faster and generates 20% more Mana.

name: Escape from Reality
description: After you use Transcendence: Transfer, you can use Transcendence: Transfer again within 10 sec, ignoring its cooldown.

name: Expeditious Fortification
description: Fortifying Brew cooldown reduced by 30 sec.

name: Fast Feet
description: Rising Sun Kick deals 70% increased damage. Spinning Crane Kick deals 10% additional damage.

name: Fatal Touch
description: Touch of Death's cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.

name: Ferocity of Xuen
description: Increases all damage dealt by 2%.

name: Flow of Chi
description:
You gain a bonus effect based on your current health.

Above 90% health: Movement speed increased by 5%. This bonus stacks with similar effects.

Between 90% and 35% health: Damage taken reduced by 5%.

Below 35% health: Healing received increased by 10%.

name: Flowing Wisdom
description: Heart of the Jade Serpent increases your haste by 10% while active.

name: Focused Thunder
description: Thunder Focus Tea now empowers your next 2 spells.

name: Gift of the Celestials
description: Reduces the cooldown of Invoke Yul'on, the Jade Serpent by 1 min, but decreases its duration to 12 sec.

name: Grace of the Crane
description: Increases all healing taken by 6%.

name: Harmonic Gambit
description: During Aspect of Harmony, Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick, and Tiger Palm also withdraw vitality to damage enemies for an additional 20% over 8 sec.

name: Harmonic Surge
description:
Casting Thunder Focus Tea grants 2 charges of Potential Energy. Your next cast of Tiger Palm or Vivify consumes all charges of Potential Energy to cause a Harmonic Surge.

Harmonic Surge:
For each charge of Potential Energy, deal 836 Nature damage to your target and 836 Nature damage to other nearby enemies, and heal up to 5 allies for 190. Damage reduced above 5 targets.

name: Hasty Provocation
description: Provoked targets move towards you at 50% increased speed.

name: Healing Elixir
description: You consume a healing elixir when you drop below 40% health or generate excess healing elixirs, instantly healing you for 15% of your maximum health.\n\nYou generate 1 healing elixir every 30 sec, stacking up to 2 times.

name: Healing Winds
description: Transcendence: Transfer immediately heals you for 10% of your maximum health.

name: Heart of the Jade Serpent
description: upon Yu'lon to increase the cooldown recovery rate of  by 75% for .

name: Improved Detox
description: Detox additionally removes all Poison and Disease effects.

name: Improved Touch of Death
description: Touch of Death can now be used on targets with less than 15% health remaining, dealing 35% of your maximum health in damage.

name: Inner Compass
description:
You switch between alignments every 8 sec, increasing a corresponding secondary stat by 2%.

Crane Stance:
Haste

Tiger Stance:
Critical Strike

Ox Stance:
Versatility

Serpent Stance: 
Mastery

name: Invigorating Mists
description: Vivify heals all allies with your Renewing Mist active for 1,199.\n\nSheilun's Gift's healing is increased by 500% on its primary target.

name: Ironshell Brew
description: Increases your maximum health by an additional 10% and your damage taken is reduced by an additional 10% while Fortifying Brew is active.

name: Jade Bond
description: Chi Cocoons now apply Enveloping Mist for 4 sec when they expire or are consumed, and Chi-Ji's Gusts of Mists healing is increased by 20% and Yu'lon's Soothing Breath healing is increased by 500%.

name: Jade Empowerment
description: Crackling Jade Lightning's damage is increased by 300% and now chains to 4 additional enemies at 25% effectiveness.

name: Jade Infusion
description: Thunder Focus Tea summons a Jade Serpent Statue at your location. When you channel Soothing Mist, the statue will also begin to channel Soothing Mist on your target, healing for 2,128 over 7.1 sec.

name: Jade Sanctuary
description: You heal for 10% of your maximum health instantly when you activate Celestial Conduit and receive 15% less damage for its duration. \n\nThis effect lingers for an additional 8 sec after Celestial Conduit ends.

name: Jade Walk
description: While out of combat, your movement speed is increased by 15%.

name: Jadefire Teachings
description: Ancient Teachings transfers an additional 270% damage to healing.\n\nYour Stamina is increased by 8%.

name: Legacy of Wisdom
description: Sheilun's Gift heals 2 additional allies and its cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.

name: Lifecycles
description: Vivify has a 20% chance to cause your next Rising Sun Kick or Enveloping Mist to generate 1 stack of Mana Tea.\n\nEnveloping Mist and Rising Sun Kick have a 20% chance to cause your next Vivify to generate 1 stack of Mana Tea.

name: Lighter Than Air
description: Roll causes you to become lighter than air, allowing you to double jump to dash forward a short distance once within 5 sec, but the cooldown of Roll is increased by 2 sec.

name: Lotus Infusion
description: Allies with Renewing Mist receive 6% more healing from you and Renewing Mist's duration is increased by 2 sec.

name: Manifestation
description: Chi Burst and Chi Wave deal 50% increased damage and healing.

name: Mantra of Purity
description: When cast on yourself, your single-target healing spells heal for 10% more and restore an additional 570 health over 6 sec.

name: Mantra of Tenacity
description: Fortifying Brew grants 20% Stagger.

name: Martial Instincts
description: Increases your Physical damage done by 5% and Avoidance increased by 2%.

name: Meditative Focus
description:
Blackout Combo:
Increases Tiger Palm damage by an additional 50% and Keg Smash reduces the cooldown on your Brews by an additional 1.0 sec.

  Press the Advantage:
Nature damage dealt by your main hand auto-attacks is increased by 100% and they now reduce the cooldown on your Brews by an additional 0.25 sec.

name: Mist Caller
description: Vivify and Sheilun's Gift trigger a Gust of Mist on yourself.

name: Mist Wrap
description: Increases Enveloping Mist's duration by 1 sec and its healing bonus by 10%.

name: Mistline
description: Renewing Mist's healing is increased by 500% on your lowest health ally with its effect.

name: Mists of Life
description: Life Cocoon applies Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist to the target.

name: Misty Coalescence
description: Renewing Mist healing is increased by up to 300% in proportion to its coverage on yourself and your allies.

name: Misty Peaks
description: Renewing Mist's heal over time effect has a 5.0% chance to apply Enveloping Mist for 2 sec.

name: Morning Breeze
description: Rising Sun Kick's damage is increased by your Mastery rating and Thunder Focus Tea resets its cooldown.

name: Niuzao's Protection
description: Fortifying Brew grants you an absorb shield for 25% of your maximum health.

name: Overflowing Mists
description: Your Enveloping Mists heal the target for 2,280 each time they take direct damage.

name: Overwhelming Force
description: Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Tiger Palm deal 15% additional damage to enemies in a line in front of you. Damage reduced above 5 targets.

name: Path of Resurgence
description: Chi Burst increases vitality stored by 25% for 10 sec.

name: Path of the Falling Star
description: Celestial Conduit's healing and damage is increased by 100% when striking a single target.\n\nEach addtional target reduces this bonus by 20%.

name: Peace and Prosperity
description: Reduces the cooldown of Ring of Peace by 5 sec and Song of Chi-Ji's cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.

name: Peaceful Mending
description: Allies targeted by Soothing Mist receive 40% more healing from your Enveloping Mist and Renewing Mist effects.

name: Pool of Mists
description: Renewing Mist now has 3 charges and reduces the remaining cooldown of Rising Sun Kick by 1.0 sec.\n\nRising Sun Kick now reduces the remaining cooldown of Renewing Mist by 1.0 sec.

name: Potential Energy
description: Casting Keg Smash grants a charge of Potential Energy.

name: Pressure Points
description: Paralysis now removes all Enrage effects from its target.

name: Purified Spirit
description: When Aspect of Harmony ends, any remaining vitality is expelled as healing over 8 sec, split among nearby targets.

name: Quick Footed
description: The duration of snare effects on you is reduced by 20%.

name: Rapid Diffusion
description: Rising Sun Kick and Enveloping Mist apply Renewing Mist for 6 seconds to an ally within 40 yds.

name: Refreshment
description: Life Cocoon grants up to 5 stacks of Mana Tea and applies 2 stacks of Healing Elixir to its target.

name: Reinvigoration
description: After Detox successfully removes an effect from an ally, their movement speed is increased by 30% for 5 sec.

name: Resplendent Mist
description: Gust of Mists has a 30% chance to do 100% more healing.

description: $?c2[Healing increased by $322118s8% while Chi-Ji, the Red Crane or Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent is active.]?c3[Damage increased by $123904s4% while Xuen, the White Tiger is active.][]

name: Rising Mist
description: Rising Sun Kick extends your Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist effects by 4 sec, up to 100% of their original duration.

name: Roar from the Heavens
description: Tiger's Lust grants 20% movement speed to up to 2 allies near its target.

name: Rushing Reflexes
description: Your heightened reflexes allow you to react swiftly to the presence of enemies, causing you to quickly lunge to the nearest enemy in front of you within 10 yards after you Roll.

name: Save Them All
description: Your healing is increased by up to 10%, based on the current health of your target. Lower health targets are healed for more.

name: Secret Infusion
description:
After using Thunder Focus Tea, your next spell gives 4% of a stat. Only one stat increase may be active at once:
Enveloping Mist: Critical strike
Renewing Mist: Haste
Rising Sun Kick: Versatility

name: Serene Surge
description: After casting Enveloping Mist, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.

name: Silent Sanctuary
description: While no enemies are within 15 yds, you heal for 1,140 every 3 sec.

name: Spirit's Essence
description: Transcendence: Transfer snares targets within 10 yds by 70% for 4 sec when cast.

name: Spiritfont
description: Rising Sun Kick and Vivify have a chance to activate Spiritfont, causing your next Enveloping Mist's cast time to be reduced by 50% and channel Soothing Mist from you onto up to 5 allies at 20% effectiveness for 8 sec.\n\nIf Spiritfont's Soothing Mists heal a full health target, they will jump to another injured ally or split its healing into your remaining Soothing Mists.

name: Stampede of the Ancients
description: Strength of the Black Ox's effect is 400% more effective on your primary target.

name: Stillstep Coil
description: Leg Sweep applies Disable for 5.0 sec when it ends.

name: Swift Art
description: Roll removes a snare effect once every 30 sec.

name: Tear of Morning
description: Your Invigorating Mist healing is increased by 20% and your Enveloping Mist also heals allies with Renewing Mist for 8% of its healing.\n\nThe duration of Enveloping Mist is increased by 4 sec while you have a celestial summoned.

description: $?c2[The healing of Enveloping Mist, Vivify, and Sheilun's Gift is increased by $s1%.]?c3[Fists of Fury and Spinning Crane Kick deal $s2% more damage.][]

description: Increases the range of Leg Sweep by 4 yds.

name: Tiger's Vigor
description: Casting Tiger's Lust reduces the remaining cooldown on Roll by 5 sec.

name: Tranquil Tea
description: Consuming Mana Tea generates 1 cloud of mist.

name: Unity Within
description: Celestial Conduit can be recast once during its duration to call upon all of the August Celestials to assist you at 200% effectiveness.\n\nUnity Within is automatically cast when Celestial Conduit ends if not used before expiration.

name: Uplifted Spirits
description: The cooldown of Revival is reduced by 30 sec and Revival healing increased by 15%.

name: Veil of Pride
description: Increases Sheilun's Gift cloud of mist generation to every 4 sec.

name: Vital Clarity
description: Vivify and Sheilun's Gift critical strike chances are increased by 15% on yourself.

name: Vivacious Vivification
description: After casting Rising Sun Kick, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.\n\nThis effect also reduces the energy cost of Vivify by 75%.

name: Way of a Thousand Strikes
description: Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Tiger Palm contribute 30% additional vitality.

name: Way of the Crane
description: Tiger Palms strike twice, Blackout Kicks strike an additional 2 targets at 20% effectiveness, and Spinning Crane Kick heals 1 nearby allies for 340% of the damage done.

name: Way of the Serpent
description: Vivify healing increased by 15% and Renewing Mist's healing is increased by 30%.

description: The range of Disable is increased by 5 yds.\n \nThe duration of Crashing Momentum is increased by 3 sec and its snare now reduces movement speed by an additional 20%.

name: Windwalking
description: You and your allies within 10 yards have 10% increased movement speed. Stacks with other similar effects.

name: Xuen's Bond
description: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger's damage is increased by 30% and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

name: Xuen's Guidance
description: Teachings of the Monastery has a 15% chance to refund a charge when consumed. \n\nThe damage of Tiger Palm is increased by 10%.

name: Yu'lon's Avatar
description: Vivify and Sheilun's Gift have a chance to trigger Heart of the Jade Serpent for 4 sec at 100% effectiveness.

name: Yu'lon's Grace
description: Find resilience in the flow of chi in battle, gaining a magic absorb shield for 1.0% of your max health every 3 sec in combat, stacking up to 10%.

name: Yu'lon's Knowledge
description: Rising Sun Kick damage increased by 15%.

name: Yu'lon's Whisper
description: While channeling Mana Tea you exhale the breath of Yu'lon, healing up to 5 allies within 15 yards for 347 every 0.4 sec.

name: Zen Pulse
description: Renewing Mist's heal over time has a chance to cause your next Vivify to also trigger a Zen Pulse on its target and all allies with Renewing Mist, healing them for 610 increased by 6% per Renewing Mist active, up to 30%.

name: Transcendence: Transfer
description: Your body and spirit swap locations.

description: Tiger Palm causes your next Blackout Kick to strike an additional time dealing 29 Physical damage, stacking up to 4.\n\nBlackout Kick has a 12% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Rising Sun Kick.
